result.title: VICA: Video Contextual Agreement for AIGC Video Detection and Localization
result.summary: The rapid advancement of AI-generated content (AIGC) video generation and editing technologies has raised growing societal concerns about the authenticity and reliability of digital videos. Existing video detection methods primarily exploit temporal inconsistencies through holistic frame-level representations, whereas manipulation localization methods focus on artifacts within individual spatial regions. However, holistic representations may obscure localized artifacts through global feature aggregation, while region-centric approaches may overlook disagreements between individual regions and their surrounding spatiotemporal context. To address these limitations, we propose VIdeo Contextual Agreement (VICA), a unified framework that masks individual video regions and leverages a frozen V-JEPA model to predict their representations from the surrounding spatiotemporal context. Complementary masking ensures complete regional coverage, while context-conditioned predictions establish references for assessing regional agreement with the broader video context. By comparing predicted and observed representations, VICA derives spatial residuals that characterize intra-frame discrepancies and bidirectional temporal residuals that capture inconsistencies across preceding and subsequent frames. These residuals characterize contextual disagreements, providing a shared forensic representation for both tasks and shifting the focus from identifying isolated manipulation artifacts to assessing regional agreement with expectations inferred from the broader video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VICA achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across multiple benchmarks, with strong generalization to unseen video generators and editing methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VICA 框架：对视频局部区域施加互补掩码，用冻结的 V-JEPA 从周围时空上下文预测被掩区域的表示，再比较预测与观测表示得到空间残差和双向时间残差，用于 AIGC 视频检测与篡改定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 「掩码区域表示预测 + 残差比较」这一线索可供核查：或可作为探测 VLM 内部状态是否保留局部视觉细节、并按上下文一致性筛选视觉证据的诊断信号，但其视频取证设定与 LVR 推理的迁移可行性尚待确认。
